## Decision

The gw-default cutover and the doc/specs cleanup/extension extend motive obsidian-native-groundwork; no new motive is opened.

## Rationale

Tickets 09/10/11/13 under this motive already scope hook-shim port, behavior parity, spec corpus migration, and legacy retirement. D4, D6, and D8 are the governing decisions for all of it. A second motive would fork the decision log across two charters and split AC coverage.

## Alternatives Considered

- Open a new motive gw-default-cutover citing obsidian-native-groundwork
- Open two motives, one per half of the effort
